entities.name: BH amination yield
observations: Exact matches for p-toluidine and 4-bromobenzotrifluoride to the diarylamine reported isolated yields of 51.4–54.2%, below the 70% high-yield threshold.
Matched conditions included DMSO, 60 °C, 16 h, phosphine ligands t-BuXPhos or AdBrettPhos, and bases MTBD or BTMG.
